item.title: Luzerne County Election Task Force schedules public meeting to discuss recommendations
item.description: Luzerne County’s bipartisan Election Task Force will hold a public meeting next month to discuss its final recommendations on ways Pennsylvania can clarify and streamline election procedures.

item.title: Brent crude briefly tops $119 per barrel, before receding, and shakes stock markets worldwide
item.description: NEW YORK — A roller-coaster day for oil prices showed how they’re dictating where financial markets and maybe even the global economy are heading. Stocks tumbled in Europe and Asia when oil prices shot higher early on Thursday, but U.S. stocks pared their sharp losses as the day progressed and oil prices fell back.

item.title: Mullin’s DHS nomination advances to full Senate despite opposition from Republican Rand Paul
item.description: WASHINGTON — Sen. Markwayne Mullin moved a step closer to becoming President Donald Trump’s next homeland security secretary after a Senate committee Thursday narrowly advanced his nomination.

item.title: Israel says it will hold off striking key Iranian natural gas field as war rattles energy markets
item.description: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates — Israel pledged to refrain from more strikes on a key Iranian gas field after Iran intensified attacks Thursday on oil and natural gas facilities around the Gulf, raising the stakes in a war that has sent shock waves through energy markets and the global economy.

item.title: Treasury Department begins taking over student loans as the Education Department gets dismantled
item.description: WASHINGTON — The U.S. Education Department is handing off a portion of its student loan portfolio to the Treasury Department, a first step toward shedding management of all student loans as Trump administration officials dismantle the federal education agency.

item.title: Northwest Area superintendent search, consolidation project are moving forward
item.description: The superintendent search at Northwest Area School District is nearing completion, Superintendent Joseph Long said at Thursday’s school board meeting.

item.title: PIAA Girls Basketball: Holy Redeemer falls in Class 3A state title game
item.description: HERSHEY — Two issues that cropped up sporadically in the first half Thursday night eventually were too much for Holy Redeemer to overcome in the second half.

item.title: Diamonds to donation drive, coal to politicians making it necessary
item.description: Diamonds to the Wilkes-Barre Scranton International Airport for sponsoring a donation drive for the Transportation Security Administration workers employed there. It is almost certainly not enough for people forced to work without pay because of unnecessary political deadlock in the U.S. Congress, but it is a move worth some praise.
